hero.title: Research Matching
hero.subtitle: Find the right research partners through an algorithm that weighs expertise, research interests and how well two people are likely to work together.

form.title: Find Your Match

features.description: More than 50 factors are weighed at once: publication history, research topics and collaboration patterns.

features.title: Compatibility Scoring
features.description: Scores come from research alignment, complementary skills and the markers of collaborations that worked.

features.title: Continuous Updates
features.description: New publications and collaborations keep feeding back in, so match quality improves over time.

results.title: Top Matches
results.subtitle: Based on your research profile and preferences.

how.title: How Matching Works
how.subtitle: Several dimensions are weighed together to find the research partners who fit best.

steps.title: Profile Analysis
steps.desc: Your research history, publications and areas of expertise are read first.

steps.title: Pattern Recognition
steps.desc: Complementary skills and overlapping research interests are identified.
